title: Visual Novel Transformer
description:
Visual Novel Converter is a desktop tool for creators that helps you turn novel text into a playable Ren'Py visual novel project.

What you can do• Import txt / docx and quickly organize them into editable story segments

• Edit dialogue, narration, scenes, and presentation settings on a timeline

• Manage cast, sprites/expressions, backgrounds, music, SFX, and other assets

• Set up branch choices, variables, and conditions to build side routes from the main story

• Export a Ren’Py project and playtest in the tool; also package a reader-ready build

• Share or get editable projects / playable builds through the Steam Workshop

Suggested workflow• Import your manuscript and segment it

• Add cast and scene assets

• Adjust presentation and branches on the timeline

• Export and playtest

• Package a reader build or publish to the Workshop

Distinctive features• Custom dark/light themes and background wallpaper

• Inspiration Notes: sticky notes on your desktop for quick ideas; built-in prompts by topic with random draws to spark writing; pin many notes and customize their paper

Who it’s for• Authors who want to turn existing novel text into an interactive visual novel

• Creators who prefer less low-level scripting and want a playable result faster

Who it’s not for• Anyone expecting a full release-ready game from zero assets with one click — you still need your manuscript, sprites, and other materials

• Developers who need deep Ren’Py scripting or complex engine extensions from the first line — better to write Ren’Py by hand directly
description_short: A visual novel creator for writers: turn your story into a playable Ren'Py project with a visual editor—faster from text to playable, packable builds.
